selected_files.content:
- name: Subir script de escaneo
  win_copy:
    src: advanced_scan.ps1
    dest: C:\Windows\Temp\advanced_scan.ps1

- name: Ejecutar script PowerShell
  win_shell: |
    powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Windows\Temp\advanced_scan.ps1
  register: scan_result

- name: Mostrar resultados
  debug:
    var: scan_result.stdout_lines

all:
  hosts:
    windows_host:
      ansible_host: 192.168.1.146
      ansible_user: automation
      ansible_password: "abcABC1234567890"
      ansible_connection: winrm
      ansible_winrm_transport: ntlm
      ansible_port: 5985

- name: Scan de posibles puertas traseras en Windows
  hosts: windows_host
  gather_facts: no
  roles:
    - scan
